protein: T7 RNA polymerase (single-subunit DNA-dependent RNA polymerase)
assay_method: Thermal shift assay / DSF with SYPRO Orange (5x). Analytik Jena qTower3; ~0.2 mg/ml protein, 20 ul, in triplicate; 25-65 degC in 0.5 degC steps with 5 s hold; Tm from a Boltzmann fit of the unfolding curve.
remark: P657L is excluded: no expression, no Tm. Activity at 52 degC is reported for only WT and 5 variants, so it is not included.

protein: T7 RNA polymerase, a single-subunit DNA-dependent RNA polymerase
assay_method: Thermal challenge of purified T7 RNA polymerase variants: aliquots were incubated for 15 min at 40, 42.5, 45, 47.5, 50, 52.5, 55, 57.5, 60 and 62.5 degC and then assayed, Tm being the midpoint of the resulting loss of transcriptional activity. Circular dichroism and differential scanning calorimetry were applied separately and only to the wild type and three selected mutants.
remark: The wild-type sequence is the 883-residue T7 RNA polymerase already used by this repository's Jiang 2024 datasets, and all 26 distinct substitutions appearing in this library verify against it. Every variant is multi-site, carrying 2 to 14 substitutions, and there is no wild-type row: the paper reports no measurement for the parent in this table, so wt_readout is empty and the score is anchored on the dataset mean. The numbers were extracted from Supplementary Tables S3 and S4 of the SI PDF, the paper having deposited no machine-readable file -- its data availability statement says only that all data are contained within the article. Table S3 gives an index-to-genotype map and Table S4 the readouts against the same index, and the two were joined on it; the row index is contiguous within every round in both tables, except that Table S3 defines a variant R4-30 for which Table S4 reports no result, so 165 defined mutants yield 164 rows here. The paper reports two different wild-type melting temperatures by two methods -- 46.9 degC from circular dichroism and calorimetry, and 42.1 degC from the incubation assay -- and puts neither in this table, which is the second reason wt_readout is left empty rather than typed. Against the 46.9 degC figure the best variant here, at 57.7 degC, is 10.8 degC above wild type, which is the paper's stated increase of more than 10 degC. Not extracted from this paper: the mRNA recovery rates of Table S1, the literature comparison of Table S2, the model scoring of Table S5, the LNP formulation of Table S6 and the transcriptional fidelity of Table S9, none of which is a per-variant measurement of this library.
